messages:
maria-finance: Hey team — noticed a mismatch on VelaHealth private deployment renewal invoice. Platform fee line appears 15% higher than the committed rate in the order form. attaching invoice snippet below. billing-bot: Invoice  INV-2026-045 uploaded by olivia-billing — https://redwood.example/invoices/INV-2026-045 

olivia-billing: copying the relevant lines from the PDF: 
```
Invoice: INV-2026-045
Customer: VelaHealth
Period: 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31
Platform fee (private deployment, standard support): $138,750
Support (standard): $18,000
Reserved capacity true-up: $0.00
```

maria-finance: Contract/order form (signed 2025-04-02) shows platform fee = $120,000 (annual) for the private deployment with standard support. looks like invoice used a different rate table. 

sam-account-exec: @olivia-billing can you confirm which pricing table generated this charge? Did VelaHealth recently move to enterprise support tier or add modules? 

olivia-billing: I pulled the billing job logs — generator used price_profile: private_v1_2026. I see a price override tag in their account: `support_tier: standard` and `platform_multiplier: 1.15625` (huh). I will attach job trace. (reacts :thinking_face:) 

olivia-billing: Trace snippet: 
```
apply_pricing(account_id=vh-1123, profile=private_v1_2026)
  base_platform=120000
  multiplier=1.15625  # from account metadata: legacy_partner_markup
  computed_platform=138750
```

maria-finance: Where did legacy_partner_markup get in? VelaHealth is a direct customer, not partner model. That should not apply. 

sam-account-exec: I checked the CRM — there was an internal note from 2023 about a negotiated partner-like discount path when we consolidated billing for a reseller program. But VelaHealth was never onboarded as reseller. looks like a tag was accidentally applied during a migration. 

raj-legal: If invoice already issued, we need to either issue a corrected invoice or credit. What's the magnitude? ~18.75k overcharge. Are there contractual caps/interest for late credits? 

maria-finance: Correct, overcharged $18,750. Contract SLA/fees section doesn't prescribe interest on billing errors; standard remedy is credit within next billing cycle. But we should not unilaterally adjust support tier lines without AE confirmation. 

tom-support: Customer reached out to support asking "why renewal increased" and included screenshot of invoice. They're asking for immediate clarification. I flagged as P1 internal. 

sam-account-exec: I'll own customer comms. Plan: tell them it's an internal billing error and we'll issue a corrected invoice and a credit note before EOD PDT. Need finance + billing ops to confirm. 

olivia-billing: I can regenerate corrected invoice if we clear which pricing profile to use (private_v1_2026, no legacy markup). Will the finance team approve issuing a credit? 

maria-finance: Approve in principle — we should issue a credit note for $18,750 and reissue invoice with platform fee $120,000. Please add an explanatory note referencing contract clause 4.2 and tag as "billing_correction: migration-tag-2023". 

raj-legal: Small ask: include a short paragraph in the credit note: "Credit issued due to internal billing configuration error; no change to contract terms; credit does not imply admission of breach." That protects us. 

sam-account-exec: Agreed. I'll review the customer message. I'll cc legal note. 

olivia-billing: Working on regenerated docs now. Expected to have credit + corrected invoice by 17:30 PDT. I'll drop them in this thread when ready. 

billing-bot: Credit note CN-2026-018 created, linked to INV-2026-045 -> CreditAmount: $18,750 (issued by olivia-billing). PDF: https://redwood.example/credits/CN-2026-018.pdf 

olivia-billing: Corrected invoice uploaded: INV-2026-045-R1 (platform fee set to $120,000). Link: https://redwood.example/invoices/INV-2026-045-R1.pdf 

maria-finance: Thanks all. Quick follow-ups: 1) olivia — add an internal ticket to remove legacy_partner_markup from non-reseller accounts (priority: high). 2) finance ops — please reconcile revenue recognition for Q2 to reflect the credit. 3) sam — send the customer a short apology + confirmation of corrected invoice. 

olivia-billing: Created GH issue #4521: remove legacy_partner_markup tag from account migration script. Assigned to eng-billing. 

tom-support: Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick fix — appreciate it." (reacts :thumbsup:) 

sam-account-exec: Sent note to VelaHealth. Closing loop. If anyone wants to add wording to the customer email, ping me. 

maria-finance: I'll follow up with revenue ops during EOD reconciliation. Closing thread once reconciliation is complete.
